answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, revoked by a single upheld challenge, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. What survives to the river is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the quill until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ocean of the next round.
